lee: Heads-up: planning a quick patch publish for py+ts tonight in the 00:30-01:30 UTC window. Need dist-tag plan, types pin, and who will own rollback.

jade: I can watch. Proposed tags: `patch-night` and fallback `patch-rollback`. For @types we'll pin `@types/redwood@1.2.6` to `types-locked`.

deploy-bot: preflight: CI green, smoke 9/9, signing key available. Artifacts staged at s3://redwood-nightdrops/1741239990/.

lee: Publish commands (audit):
```
./scripts/publish.sh --packages=py,ts --disttag=patch-night --dry-run
./scripts/publish.sh --packages=py,ts --disttag=patch-night --sign --rotate-token
npm dist-tag add @types/redwood@1.2.6 types-locked
```

omar: Rollback triggers: any TS consumer import errors, pip wheel checksum mismatch, or publish 5xx. Rollback steps: 1) move dist-tag back to last stable, 2) yank wheel from proxy, 3) republish stable from release branch, 4) notify #integrations. I'll be rollback owner if needed.

kate: Docs: adding a short deprecation note for legacy sync client to the draft release notes now. ETA 20m.

jade: I'll run consumer `tsc --noEmit` and a quick python smoke after sign. Timeout: 01:00 UTC forced rollback if any high-sev.

lee: Starting dry-run in ~5m. Will post status and dist-tag flip when live. :thumbsup:
